title: Audit one complete backward pass
promptMarkdown: For x=(1,−2), W₁=[[1,0],[0,1]], b₁=(1,1), w₂=(3,−1), b₂=0 and target y=1, let f=w₂·ReLU(W₁x+b₁)+b₂ and L=½(f−y)². Compute every parameter gradient and one simultaneous gradient step of size0.01. Recompute the new loss. Write a standard-library finite-difference check for at least one active and one inactive incoming weight using ε=10⁻⁶. Explain the ReLU-kink limitation and why the loss change is evidence about this step only.
hintLadder: Cache the original activations and output error.
Apply the ReLU mask before forming the outer product with x.
All updates use old gradients; finite differences change one parameter at a time.
